message.content: {"edits":[{"op":"remove_component","component":"M7","why":"Spurious detection on the P5 drain wire; the real P7 is M9."},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M2","pin":"Drain","net":"tail","why":"P2 drain feeds the P5/P6 source tail, not the mirror gate net."},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M5","pin":"Source","net":"tail"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M6","pin":"Source","net":"tail"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M5","pin":"Body","net":"tail"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M9","pin":"Source","net":"net6","why":"P7 source connects to the P5 drain."},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M9","pin":"Drain","net":"mir","why":"P7 drain connects to the N3 drain, which is the N3/N4 mirror node."},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M13","pin":"Drain","net":"mir"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M13","pin":"Gate","net":"mir"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"M14","pin":"Gate","net":"mir"},{"op":"set_pin","component":"R1","pin":"Neg","net":"net14","why":"R1 is in series with C."},{"op":"set_pin","component":"C1","pin":"Neg","net":"net3","why":"The other end of C goes to OUT."}]}
message.reasoning:
I'm mapping out the circuit: the P1 and P2 current mirror off VDD, with P1's drain feeding P3's source. P2's drain ties to the tail at P5 and P6. P3's gate is shared with the P7/P8 bias pair, and its drain runs down at (155,176) to N2's drain.

Now I'm checking the pipeline's device list against the schematic, starting with P1 and P2's drains. P2's drain looks like it belongs to the P5/P6 tail rather than net1, so I'm thinking about giving it a separate tail net.

I'm trying to work out what P4's gate is tied to, since the line near (455,156) could run back to the P2 drain or tail node, or it could be the line at y=62. If it's on the tail node, that would be an odd bias, so I'm checking the wire path against the image.

I'm checking the P1 and P2 drain wiring against the gate lines around (212,82) and (330,120). The P2 drain at (326,100) looks like it meets the P5/P6 tail node, and that same node may be feeding P4's gate through the horizontal wire at y=120, which would be an unusual bias to work out.

I'm still trying to pin down where P4's gate actually connects, since the wire near y=120 could tie to the mirror gate net or to the P2 drain junction. Checking the picture for that dot at (326,120) to decide.

Still checking whether P4's gate is really on the mirror net, since tying it to the tail would short everything together. The P3 gate and drain connections look like they might be lumped into one net that doesn't match the schematic, so I'm comparing those junctions against the image.

I'm checking whether P3's gate is diode-connected to its own drain, with a wire running from the gate near x=205 down toward the P7/P8 gate line at y=262. I need to see if that wire actually reaches the drain node at (155,176) or stops short.

Now I'm checking P7's source and drain connections against the bias net, since its drain currently lands on the same net as the gates.

I'm working out which nets should merge: the N3 drain, its gate, the N4 gate, and the P7 drain all belong on one new mirror net, while the bias net keeps the P3 gate and drain, the P7/P8 gates, and the N2 drain. I also see that P7's source is pointing at a dangling net and should instead connect to the P5 drain.

I'm dropping the spurious M7 detection, since it overlaps the P5 drain wire and P7 already shows up separately as M9. Then I'm reassigning P5 and P6's sources to the new tail net, along with P2's drain, and I'm leaving the body connection on M6 for later.

I'm checking the R1 and C1 nodes now: R1's negative side is wired to the wrong net, so it should go to the C1 positive node, and C1's negative side should land on the output net instead.

I'm updating the net assignments: the N3 gate and P7's drain go onto the new mirror net, along with M9, M13 and M14, while M8's gate stays on the bias net. The N1/N2 gates and sources look right already, and the VSS bodies and the R2/R3 returns need no change.
